tools.name: outlook_send_mail
tools.description: Send an HTML email notification (report, escalation, or shift summary) from the dedicated service mailbox to a pre-approved distribution list or recipient. This is a write action restricted to pre-approved distribution lists/mailboxes; it cannot send to arbitrary external domains without an explicit allow-list entry.

to_recipients.description: Email addresses, must resolve to a pre-approved distribution list or mailbox.

tools.name: outlook_get_inbound_messages
tools.description: Retrieve inbound messages from the service mailbox's inbox matching a sender/subject filter (e.g., vendor quotes, technician notes). Optional ingestion path; not enabled for this use case in the initial rollout scope.

tools.name: outlook_check_delivery_status
tools.description: Check the delivery/bounce (NDR) status of a previously sent message, used to detect repeated bounces for a distribution-list data-quality alert.
